description: Create a billing subscription via POST /v1/billing/subscriptions. plan_id is the id of a previously created billing plan. Returns the subscription with status (APPROVAL_PENDING) and HATEOAS approve link for the buyer.

application_context.description: Optional application_context (brand_name, locale, return_url, cancel_url, user_action).

body.description: Additional subscription body fields merged into the request.

quantity.description: Quantity of the product in the subscription.

start_time.description: ISO 8601 start time. Defaults to immediate.

name: create_subscription
